# Synthetic Process Edit Records

This cumulative file contains direct-video-reviewed edits. The taxonomy was allocated jointly across all 100 videos; records are finalized in 20-video review batches.

- Reviewed videos: 100/100
- Reviewed records: 300/300
- Branches: `E1: A_to_B`, `E2A: A_to_D`, `E2B: B_to_C`
- Time rules: E1 is before 20 seconds; E2A and E2B are at or after 20 seconds; every command is before 37 seconds; E1-to-E2B is at most 15 seconds
- Instruction policy: English command text contains only timing, target, and requested operation; preservation requirements remain in structured fields
- Review status: batch `001-100` complete
